runtime.mount: base-relative links; platform tenantPath; custom-domain compatible
runtime.database: PostgreSQL via services.db; schema.sql idempotent; every setting has a default in lib/store.js (seed.js optional)

data.business.json: facts from the public listing at build time + the full service catalog (listed/confirmed) + the design; owner settings override at read time
data.admin_settings: owner settings: business_name, phone, email, areas_fr/en, payments_fr/en, hours_json, emergency_247, rbq, neq, tps_number, tvq_number, interac_email, business_address/address_public, privacy_fr/en, service_<id> = confirmed|proposed|hidden, service_<id>_price (cents), doc_terms_fr/en, estimate_valid_days, invoice_due_days, charge_taxes, notification_email; inline-editor text overrides _p_lk_*
data.plumbing_requests: estimate requests (web form or logged calls): status new|contacted|done|lost
data.documents: estimates (E<year>-0001 at creation) and invoices (F<year>-0001 when issued); token = private customer link

gates.privacy_approved: bilingual privacy policy completed (no [placeholders]) and approved

design.illustrations: the home cutaway (lib/cutaway.js): inline SVG coloured by CSS variables; service cards and pages show detail crops of it. No photographs, no real property, no logo copied.

contentRules: No invented licences, staff, years, testimonials, prices, warranties or response times (a Québec RBQ number only from the register)
Services not confirmed by a verified listing are shown « À confirmer »
Hours, areas, payments and free estimates only from a verified listing or the owner
Rating only with ≥ 10 reviews, dated, linked to Google
No public address unless the owner sets one and ticks address_public

sources.notes: Profile individually opened; business identity, phone, rating, review count, address if displayed and outbound website observed.
Outbound directory/social link observed on Maps; page not independently verified.
Focused name/phone search found directories. ReseauPlombier Site internet link resolves to Facebook, not an owned domain; no owned website identified, absence unproven.
